learned.title: Week one of the timing test: too close to call
learned.note: Seven posts went a day early, seven at the old day-of slot. The share is the number that decides it: sixteen shared posts in four weeks average 164 people, the other forty-four average 27. The sides swap this week; the call comes Nov 23, or sooner at two to one with twenty posts a side.

moves.title: The Reel comes out
moves.why: Three Reels read 27, 19 and 16 against 23 for an ordinary post. Opening on the feature made the watch time worse: 7.5 seconds, 73% skipped.
moves.plan: From Wed Nov 4 no Reel is cut or posted. Three cuts read 27, 19 and 16 people against 23 for the week's ordinary post, and the third was watched 7.5 seconds. Say don't and it keeps going, opening on the feature.

moves.title: Half the posts go out a day early
moves.why: Week one: a day early shared 1 of 7, day-of 2 of 7. Seven a side is too few to call; it runs on, sides swapped.
moves.plan: From Wed Oct 28 half of each week's dated posts go out 24 hours before their old slot, the other half at the old time, swapping each week, so the venue and the act have a day to reshare. The review reads the two sides every Monday and picks the winner by Nov 23. Say don't and every post stays day-of.
